candidate_design.name: rawMitra conditional error-probability detector
candidate_design.training_target: e_i = 1[(inner_oof_probability_i >= 0.5) != y_i], computed only within the outer training partition.
candidate_design.training_features: Existing 30 engineered attributes plus inner rawMitra probability, margin abs(p-0.5), and predicted class. Categorical vocabulary and any transforms fitted on outer training rows only.
candidate_design.query_features: Same attributes plus authenticated outer rawMitra probability; no query labels or historical error flags.
candidate_design.candidate_model: One fixed small binary classifier, implementation and parameters to be committed before fitting after runtime inspection; no parameter sweep.
candidate_design.decision: Flip the raw predicted class only when estimated error probability exceeds 0.5; no class balancing or threshold search.
candidate_design.probability_formula: Let c=1[p_raw>=0.5], q=P(raw prediction incorrect|X,p_raw); p_new=c*(1-q)+(1-c)*q. At q==0.5 retain original predicted class.
candidate_design.comparison: Matched rawMitra and previous nonlinear residual, same original three outer folds. Reuse inner base predictions; no new foundation-model CV.
limitations: Alternative error representation adds no information by itself; it may fail like existing residual models.
